name: 布忍者
look: A tiny cute cartoon felt ninja toy, made of soft dark navy felt with visible stitching, a red headband with long tails, only big round eyes visible through the mask, a little felt sword on the back, chibi proportions
style: simple flat vector illustration style with thick dark outlines and soft cel shading, like a children's picture book sticker, plain solid white background, no shadow, no text

poses.idle: Full body visible, standing on the ground facing slightly to the left with a friendly sneaky smile, arms relaxed

poses.dizzy: Full body visible, sitting on the ground dizzy with swirly spiral eyes and tongue sticking out, head tilted
poses.surprised: Full body visible, standing with mouth wide open in shock, both hands on cheeks, eyes huge
poses.hide: Full body visible, standing stiffly holding a small green leaf in front of its face to hide, but the whole body is obviously visible, eyes peeking over the leaf, convinced nobody can see it
poses.throw: Full body visible, leaping to the left and throwing a little round grey smoke ball, dramatic ninja action pose
